chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Al-Harrani, from Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Nawfaly, who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'I broke my fast on the Day of Al-Fitr with figs and a date.' So he said to me, 'You have gathered together a blessing and a Sunnah.'

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: The Day of Breaking the Fast (Eid al-Fitr)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of breaking the fast with figs and dates on Eid al-Fitr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Hasan al-Mu'izz (peace be upon him) validates the narrator's practice of breaking the Eid al-Fitr fast with figs and dates, highlighting the synthesis of divine blessing (*barakah*) and Prophetic tradition (*sunnah*). This reflects the Shia emphasis on adhering to the specific customs of the Ahl al-Bayt, where simple natural foods are elevated through spiritual intention and prophetic precedent. The narration underscores the importance of following the Imams' guidance in daily rituals to attain both physical sustenance and spiritual reward.
